tools.name: check_websites
tools.description: Makes live requests from the Zovo edge network to up to 10 public URLs and reports each verdict, redirect chain, HTTP status, response time, TLS, page title and security headers, plus a CSV download. Use for a current availability, redirect or status check. It cannot check zovo.one or its subdomains

tools.name: check_security_headers
tools.description: Checks one public URL from the Zovo edge network and reports the six key security headers with an A-F grade, HTTP status, verdict, response time, TLS, robots.txt and a CSV download. The headers are Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options or frame-a
